tickets.title: Path traversal vulnerability in CLI scaffold (bin/index.js)
tickets.notes: Fixed: bin/index.js:31 validates projectName with /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$/ and rejects .. and absolute paths. bin/index.js:38 checks targetDir is inside cwd.

tickets.title: publish.yml missing NODE_AUTH_TOKEN — npm publish always fails
tickets.notes: Won't-fix: npm publishing uses OpenID Connect (OIDC) provenance, not tokens. Auth handled by trust relationship between npm package and GitHub repo. Documented in .agents-harness.md.

tickets.title: Placeholder test suite — pnpm test always passes
tickets.notes: Fixed: Replaced placeholder assert.ok(true) with 10 real CLI scaffold tests covering: directory creation, package name/private flag, bin/files removal, tickets.json reset, missing args, path traversal, invalid chars, non-empty dir rejection, empty dir acceptance, excluded dirs. All 11 tests pass.

tickets.title: No LICENSE file — package.json claims MIT but no license text ships
tickets.notes: Fixed: Created MIT LICENSE file and added it to package.json files array. npm tarball now ships license text.

tickets.title: README doesn't document CLI usage (npx @vdpdev/harness)
tickets.notes: Fixed: Added 'Usage' section to README showing 'npx @vdpdev/harness my-project' as the primary entry point. Separated scaffold usage from contributor quick start.

tickets.title: README scripts table has wrong command syntax for tickets
tickets.notes: Won't-fix: pnpm run tickets list works correctly. pnpm passes 'list' as argument to scripts/tickets.ts which dispatches to the list command. Both 'pnpm run tickets list' and 'pnpm run tickets:list' produce identical output.

tickets.title: --quick flag in local-ci.sh is dead code — does nothing
tickets.notes: Fixed: local-ci.sh now passes 'quick' arg to repo-health when QUICK=1. Step 9 conditionally runs 'pnpm run repo-health quick' instead of always running the full suite.

tickets.title: TOCTOU race in ticket mutations — read outside lock, write inside
tickets.notes: Fixed: Moved readJson() inside withLock() callback in claim.ts, done.ts, release.ts, and add.ts. Read-modify-write is now atomic under the lock. Concurrent agents can no longer clobber each other's changes.

tickets.title: release command bypasses FSM transition guards
tickets.notes: Fixed: Added canTransition('ticket', ticket.status, 'release', ...) check to release.ts before mutating status. release now validates FSM transitions like claim and done do.

tickets.title: check-package-manager postinstall is a no-op — warns but never blocks
tickets.notes: Won't-fix: CONTRIBUTING.md:16-17 explicitly states 'the postinstall script only warns — but you'll drift from the lockfile, so prefer pnpm.' This is intentional non-blocking behavior, not a bug. The LLM that filed this didn't read CONTRIBUTING.md.

tickets.title: No JSON.parse error handling in readJson / readStore
tickets.notes: Fixed: Added try/catch to readJson (tickets/read-json.ts) and readStore (jsonstore/read-store.ts). Corrupted JSON now shows actionable error message and exits 1 instead of raw SyntaxError.

tickets.title: tsconfig rootDir excludes test/ from typecheck
tickets.notes: Won't-fix: tsconfig correctly scopes to src/ because this is a boilerplate/scaffold project. Test files in test/ are user-written and depend on src/ — they cannot be typechecked until the user actually writes them. This is standard for scaffold projects.

tickets.title: Node version mismatch: .nvmrc=22 but engines>=18
tickets.notes: Won't-fix: .nvmrc pins Node 22 for local development convenience. engines>=18 declares minimum supported version. These serve different purposes — .nvmrc is for contributors, engines is for consumers. Standard pattern for projects tested on one version but supporting older LTS.

tickets.title: Missing npm registry metadata (repository, keywords, author)
tickets.notes: Fixed: Added repository, homepage, bugs, keywords, and author fields to package.json. npm page now shows proper metadata and links.

tickets.title: Bin/ excluded from linting — security-relevant file unprotected
tickets.notes: Fixed: Removed bin/ from ESLint ignores. Added bin-specific config with Node.js globals (process, console, import) so bin/index.js is now linted.

tickets.title: npm tarball ships stale agent scratch data
tickets.notes: Fixed: Replaced 'scripts/' in package.json files array with explicit subdirectories (scripts/tickets.ts, scripts/tickets/, scripts/jsonstore-layers/, etc.) to exclude scripts/.tmp/ from the npm tarball. Verified with npm pack --dry-run — temp.json no longer ships.

tickets.title: npm tarball ships internal tickets.json
tickets.notes: Fixed in same commit as H-016. Removed tickets.json from package.json files array. Internal tickets no longer ship to scaffolded projects. bin/index.js:84-90 already resets tickets.json for scaffolded projects, so the entry point still works.

tickets.title: package.json missing main/exports/types
tickets.notes: Won't-fix: This is a CLI scaffolder, not a library. src/index.ts is a placeholder comment for users to replace. No library entry points are needed because the package is consumed via 'npx @vdpdev/harness <name>' (bin entry), not as an import.

tickets.title: SECURITY.md contradicts package version
tickets.notes: Fixed: Removed 'pre-1.0' from SECURITY.md:5 to match package.json version 1.0.0. Now says 'under active development' without version claim.

tickets.title: verify-coverage exits 0 on failures in non-CI mode
tickets.notes: Fixed: Removed the 'if (CI) process.exit(1)' guard in verify-coverage.ts. Now always exits 1 on failures regardless of mode. Local runs no longer give false green.

tickets.title: test-coverage write-store has no locking
tickets.notes: Fixed: Added set-fields-batch command to jsonstore that applies multiple record patches under a single lock. test-coverage write-store now calls set-fields-batch instead of N separate set-fields calls. Atomicity guaranteed.

tickets.title: release-lock doesn't verify ownership
tickets.notes: Fixed: Both release-lock implementations (tickets and jsonstore) now read the PID from the lock file and skip deletion if the holder is a different alive process. Only deletes if current PID matches or holder is dead.

tickets.title: postinstall depends on tsx which may not be available
tickets.notes: Fixed: Removed misleading '(y/n)' prompt and '(Skipping interactive prompt)' text from check-package-manager.ts. Now just warns cleanly. Also simplified the detection logic.

tickets.title: busy-wait spin lock burns CPU
tickets.notes: Fixed: Replaced busy-wait spin loops in both acquire-lock implementations with Atomics.wait which suspends the thread without burning CPU.

tickets.title: glob-to-suffix missing null guard
tickets.notes: Fixed: Added null/empty guards to glob-to-suffix.ts. Returns empty string for undefined/empty input instead of crashing with TypeError.

tickets.title: .env.example is empty — no guidance for new users
tickets.notes: Won't-fix: project uses no environment variables. Empty .env.example serves as a signal that env vars may be needed in forked projects. Harmless placeholder.
